history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). A small, silver stud earring is visible in his left ear. The background shows a pedestrian walkway paved with light-colored tiles. To the left, a brightly lit storefront with large glass windows displays clothing on racks and mannequins, with several people visible inside and reflected in the glass. To the right and further down the street, a man in a dark t-shirt and jeans walks away from the camera. The overall lighting is dim, suggesting it is evening or nighttime, with the storefront providing a strong source of artificial light. The color palette is dominated by dark tones of the man's clothing and the street, contrasted with the brighter interior of the shop and the light-colored pavement. The mood is casual and urban.
